title: Family call

asks: Your mum called. Her BP drugs have finished and she needs {amount} to refill them.
Your younger brother's school fees are due. Daddy is asking if you can send {amount}.
Grandma is in the hospital again. The family is putting money together and your part is {amount}.
Your cousin is getting married next month. Everyone is contributing, and they're counting on you for {amount}.
Rain flooded your aunty's shop. She's asking for {amount} to restock before market day.

pay.message: You sent {amount}. They're praying for you.

decline.message: You said not this time. The call ended quietly, and it stays with you.

declineBroke.message: You told them you don't have it right now. They understand, but it still hurts to say.

effect.expiredMessage: You didn't get back to them in time. The family noticed.

todo: TODO: unsure how much and how often to ask, and how much a yes or no should move family and morale; tune after play-testing
